sections.changelog:
Added

  • Clear button: a small "×" appears inside the search field once something is typed, clearing it in one tap.
  • Search-bar height and font-size controls in Appearance (0 = automatic from the size preset), alongside the existing width setting.

Changed

  • Full reindex now runs one batch at a time driven from the browser, so it keeps progressing on hosts where background cron does not fire reliably, without loading the server. "Items in index" now shows a live count instead of only updating when a reindex finishes.

Fixed

  • The live dropdown no longer blanks a theme's mobile menu when the search bar is placed inside it (a closed results panel could cover the screen on mobile).
